# Greater Invisibility (`spells:greater-invisibility`)
**Level 4 [Illusion](../magic-schools/illusion.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** up to 1 minute | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.
